verdict.rationale: Linear ships a built-in 'Linear Agent' that users can delegate issues to, assign work, write code, edit text, draft updates, and run recurring Loops, all documented extensively in first-party changelog and docs (e.g., linear-docs-21, -25, -36, -41, -54). Community evidence doesn't directly corroborate the agent feature but also doesn't contradict it. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the assistant's real-world reliability and no third-party review of the delegation workflow.
